verdict.rationale: Marqeta presents itself as API-first ('open APIs'). The Core API is documented across the main program objects: users, businesses, card products, cards, card state transitions, velocity and authorization controls, transactions, Mastercard disputes, JIT funding, webhooks and sandbox simulations. That suggests most operations are API-accessible, but no evidence states parity with a UI or dashboard, or compares the two. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, coverage of admin/dashboard-only functions (e.g., reporting, program configuration, user/role management), a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent corroboration.
